overview:
The **Sith Invasion of Taris** (3683 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Great Galactic War**, fought on or above **Taris**. Sith imperial troopers marching through taris undercity rubble while republic evacuation transports lift off under orbital bombardment.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Great Galactic War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Sith Invasion of Taris within the broader **Great Galactic War** campaign. Front-line reports describe sith imperial troopers marching through taris undercity rubble while republic evacuation transports lift off under orbital bombardment.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3683 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Great Galactic War.
significance: The Sith Invasion of Taris illustrates how the Great Galactic War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
